description.en:
Registers a named rectangular zone of the pitch, so the hazard maps can tag it with floor attributes (CMND_BTL_ADD_FLOOR_ATTR) and trigger floor events on it (CMND_BTL_TRIGGER_FLOOR_EV).

The rectangle is given as a corner and a size, not as two corners: the engine treats a position as inside the zone when its X lies between x and x + width (and likewise in Z with z and depth). For example the quicksand map splits the pitch in two with (-137, 0, 274, 283) and (-137, -283, 274, 283).
Up to 12 zones can exist at once; further registrations are ignored. A new zone starts with no attributes. CMND_BTL_ALL_RESET_FLOOR removes every zone.
Zone name, e.g. "FL01". The other floor functions find the zone by this name (hashed with CRC32).
Size of the zone along X.
Size of the zone along Z.

true once the call has run, including when the 12 zones are already used and nothing was registered.
null if the match system is not ready or fewer than 5 arguments were given.
